cd /workspace/tmp && cat > perfsweep.py <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import biggen, hardgen

specs = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
tl = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 55.0
worst = []
for sp in specs:
    kind = sp.pop('kind','big')
    seed = sp.pop('seed', 0)
    inst = biggen.build(seed, **sp) if kind=='big' else hardgen.PATTERNS[sp.pop('pat')](seed=seed, **sp)
    data = json.dumps(inst)
    t0=time.time()
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'], input=data, text=True,
                           capture_output=True, cwd='/', timeout=tl)
        el=time.time()-t0
        o = json.loads(r.stdout.splitlines()[0]) if r.stdout.strip() else {}
        print('%-58s %6.1fs %s k=%s' % (json.dumps(sp)[:58], el, o.get('status'), o.get('min_faults')))
        if r.stderr: print('   ERR:', r.stderr[-300:].replace('\n','|'))
        worst.append((el, sp))
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        print('%-58s TIMEOUT >%.0fs' % (json.dumps(sp)[:58], tl))
        worst.append((tl*2, sp))
worst.sort(reverse=True)
print('WORST:', json.dumps(worst[0][1]) if worst else None, worst[0][0] if worst else 0)
PYEOF
